description: With murder in his heart, Shin takes off to shoot down Kanzaki, the man who betrayed him. But can he live with the consequences when he finds out Ryoko is on the plane he just fired upon?
Kanzaki joins forces with the mafia to have Shin assassinated! Meanwhile, Shin awaits judgement for firing upon Kanzaki's civilian jet liner!

Discover the secrets of Ryoko's father and his brush with death in World War II, when Ryoko recalls the day she first met Shin aboard her father's plane. Meanwhile, around the world, Invulnerable Charlie has returned to Area 88...this time to kill Shin!
Shin's actions may cost Saki his eyesight, and Shin discovers not only why Saki commands a mercenary air force, but the reason for the x-brand on his forehead. Aviation action ideal for new readers!
Crazy Charlie is back at Area 88 with a mission no one could ever imagine. And Charlie always succeeds!
Mick's new Tomcat challenges Shin's Dragon in a battle of skill, speed and thrills!
With his new plane, Shin is safe in the sky. But can he survive the dangers of Area 88?
If the best pilots at Area 88 can't defend the base...then who can?
Captured by enemy forces, Mick is presented with a strange offer from Saki's brother, Rishar!

Shin sets off to discover the location and motives of the mysterious third force embroiled in the Asran civil war. But remote-control planes and guided missiles spell certain death for Area 88's number one pilot!

Hours of hope pass in vain for the soldiers of Area 88 waiting for Shin's return. But when word of Shin's death reaches Area 88, Mick launches himself into a blind frontal attack against the mysterious third army!
Shin's joyful prison reunion with Mick is cut short when a daring escape plan is beset by complications. Then in London, Saki and his bodyguard become victims of "A Howling in the Fog"!

A Mach 2 escape flight in two of Farina's robot planes has Shin and Mick anxiously awaiting their return to Area 88. All goes well until they discover the remote-activated self-destruct mechanisms within each plane! Will they make it, or will Farina discover their escape and blow them out of the sky? The answer awaits in "A Dark Cloud Over the Intrigue"!

Upon her return to Kansas, Dorothy has some explaining to do! After a tearful reunion with her Aunt Em and Uncle Henry, Dorothy recounts her adventures in the magical land of Oz. She details the quest for Glenda the Good Witch of the South, the solution to the curse of the winged monkeys, and the Cowardly Lion's ascent to being the King of Beasts!

Gronk is a monster... and not a very good one. Follow Gronk's adventures as she leaves the monster world and joins up with her new family! Enjoy the first year's worth of comics from this popular, all-ages webcomic in a wonderful, full color collection!

The second collection of Katie Cook's popular webcomic! Gronk is a monster who is learning to adjust to OUR world through the teachings of Dale, a woman who probably shouldn't be teaching anyone how to adjust to the real world. Join Gronk, Dale, Harli and Kitty for another year of fun!

Note: The digital edition (4/6/2015) for this volume was released before the print edition.

The third volumes of Katie Cook's popular webcomic, Gronk: A Monster's Tale, is here! Full color and jam-packed with funny, follow Gronk and her peculiar clan through another year of misunderstandings, friendship and adorable mayhem.

The latest, full-color volume of Katie Cook’s popular webcomic, Gronk! This new installment has never been in print before and is coming to Action Lab as a brand-spankin’ NEW book! Follow Gronk and her friends’ adventures for another silly, fun, weird year. Like cats? This book has ‘em. Like dogs? We have those too. Like tiny green monsters? Look no further, you’ve found your new favorite book!

NEW SERIES!

Disregarded, disrespected and dismissed, Renny has a chip on his shoulder.

Once an equal partner in a criminal syndicate that rules Las Vegas, he now finds himself living in a shack in the desert. But the shack has a workshop, and Renny's been busy. It's time to march his robot army into the neon hell of a cyberpunk Vegas and retake his seat at the table. Or take the wood from the table and build enough caskets for the whole syndicate.

Old friends better run, because Operation PATIENCE! CONVICTION! REVENGE! is underway.

Like an Elmore Leonard novel set in the world of Blade Runner, PATIENCE! CONVICTION! REVENGE! is offbeat and often funny, but all about the dark corners of cities and minds. A violent criminal genius with a bad case of monomania makes for the most fun you'll have with a comic this year.

Written by Patrick Kindlon (There's Nothing There, We Can Never Go Home) and drawn by Marco Ferrari (Famous Monsters Presents) PATIENCE! CONVICTION! REVENGE! continues Kindlon's exploration of difficult characters and irreverent themes. Having broken the chains of good taste, Kindlon goes all-in and writes a vengeance-obsessed lunatic as if he's riding beside him-all wrapped in a gangster tale like no other, and that HAD to be told at AfterShock!

description: MILES MORALES and his AMAZING FRIENDS! Need all the help they can get! Spider-Man does whatever a spider can - but he'll need hand from his super-powered friends (and frenemies) to handle Bumbler's string of art robberies, Hightail's super-speedy secret mission and Frost Pharaoh's assault on Brooklyn Visions Academy! Astonishing Miles Morales: Spider-Man Infinity Comic (2025) #1-6 for the first time in print!

Fans of Mike Allred's Madman will be happy to know that Dr. Robot, the delightful comic strip by Bernie Mireault, creator of The Jam, will be reprinted in a special issue featuring all four color strips that originally appeared in Madman along with some new never-before-seen artwork. Follow the giant happy robot as he fights monsters, falls in love, and faces off against other giant robots.

description: We’re back with another collector’s item comic starring America’s favorite BFFs Betty and Veronica! Hit the beach with this special collection of some of the best and most eye-catching Betty and Veronica swimsuit images, pin-ups, fashion pages, and one-page comics, collected for the first time ever in a comic-size format!
